title: An agent operating a canvas UI
blurb: A form drawn through a shader offers three WebMCP tools. Each tool call turns the panel to face you, moves a marker to the field and types into the real input. The Prompt API can plan the calls from a sentence and describe a picture of the canvas.
question: Can a canvas show what an agent is doing to a live form (which field, which value), and can WebMCP tools and the Prompt API drive it?
result: A tool call sets four CSS custom properties and the input's value; a shader draws the marker and the lean from them. WebMCP and the Prompt API were missing or without a model in the test browser, so those paths aren't verified.
